name: creator_0470 and Catrice makeup product demos
what_it_is: ASMR-style close-up demos, swatches and tutorials for drugstore makeup products — mostly creator_0470 items (setting balm, grip primer, bubble blush, mascara, advent calendar) plus a Catrice solid perfume bar and highlighters. Videos show texture tests, application routines and unboxings rather than one shared event.
